definitions.cluster_rule: per family: >=2 distinct family-qualifying decision units (literal CIKs for the frozen family) at one issuer over filing dates [d-9, d]; formations use <2 -> >=2 crossings with re-arm
definitions.entry_event_unit: issuer CIK x FILING_DATE (available_after_date); entry at the first vendor session strictly after it

families.CEO_CFO: at least one owner with the Officer relationship flag and a CEO/CFO title
families.FROZEN_FV_PROXY_10WD: frozen first-vertical signal taken literally (distinct O/D CIKs, D07 2.1-2.2) with regular sessions approximated by weekdays; rate estimate only, not the frozen object
families.FROZEN_FV_PROXY_10WD_MERGED: SENSITIVITY: the frozen proxy with decision-unit merging; not a grid family
families.OD: at least one officer/director owner by relationship flag (10%-only and Other-only excluded; titles never promote)
families.OD_CLUSTER_10CD: crossing <2 -> >=2 distinct O/D decision units over filing dates [d-9,d], re-armed below 2; owners on one accession or with an identical (date, shares, per-share) row are one unit (PIT merge)

definitions.filing_lag: FILING_DATE - earliest TRANS_DATE of the accession's kept rows, calendar days

populations.primary: original Form 4 P/A, common-equity titles, frozen footnote/remarks exclusions, exact duplicates removed (first seen), backdated accessions excluded
populations.unfiltered: SENSITIVITY ONLY: original Form 4 P/A with backdated accessions excluded, before title/footnote/duplicate filters

definitions.roles: CEO_CFO = Officer flag + CEO/CFO title; OTHER_OFFICER = Officer flag otherwise; DIRECTOR; TEN_PERCENT_OWNER; OTHER. Role counts are non-exclusive; primary role uses that precedence
definitions.value_basis: sum of reported shares x reported per-share figure on the issuer day (window sum for crossing families); rows without a reported per-share figure contribute 0
